notes.title: Happy Holidays!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35115077/64cd133e9d22b4e76d2a15b22ef0839167f07be6.png[/img]

Happy Holidays guys! I hope everyone is looking forward to the new year, and enjoying some time off to take it easy and play games. We are going to hit the ground running in 2020 and I can't wait to share what we've been working on!

[h2]January Roadmap[/h2]
[b]Unit Tiers[/b]
Multiple unit tiers is something that has been planned from the beginning, and we are finally implementing it. Super excited to show this off.
[b]Combat AI[/b]
Rebuilt combat AI to make them more intelligent and interesting to battle
[b]New Faction[/b]
Hopefully we can introduce a third faction into the game this month!
[b]Public Testing(?)[/b]
We'll see if we get this far, would be awesome to get more player feedback :)


Happy Holidays!
Patrick from Red Fox Studios
